title: depth-chart collector signal fields
description: Two grains. `team_depth_chart` is one row per charted player: who is ahead of whom. `depth_chart_stability` is one row per (team, position) group: whether that ordering can be believed. Fields that are `null` on every row today are contracted as nullable rather than omitted, because the generator must be able to tell 'this collector does not know' from 'this field does not exist' — see services/depth-chart/depth_chart/capture.py for why each one is unknown and what would make it knowable.

player_id.description: Canonical id from player-identity. Null until a shared player-identity client lands in collector-core; join on `gsis_id` meanwhile.

gsis_id.description: The feed's published crosswalk id, which player-identity adopts as a Tier-1 link. Null when the chart row carried none.

functional_rank.description: Computed in-repo from usage-share, which is not built. Null until it is.

disagreement.description: official_rank - functional_rank. Null while either is missing.

role_label.description: Only the labels this upstream determines. Alignment- and usage-derived labels stay null rather than being guessed.

is_starter.description: Opened the most recent game at the position — a participation fact this feed does not carry. Not the same claim as official_rank == 1.

roster_status.description: Reconciled against roster-transactions, which is not registered yet.

weeks_at_rank.description: Consecutive publication weeks at this rank. A lower bound, capped by the adapter's retained history.

chart_hash.description: Hash of the canonically sorted (rank, player) ordering — never of the response bytes.

comparisons.description: Week-to-week comparisons the retained history supported — stability_score's denominator, carried so a consumer can tell a confident 1.0 from an unevidenced one.

stability_score.description: 1 - rank_changes/comparisons. Null when comparisons is 0: a single observed week is no evidence of stability, and 0/0 must not read as perfect.

chart_age_days.description: now - chart_published_at. The independent axis a high stability_score must be cross-checked against, because a frozen chart drives that score to 1.0.
